name: anhedral
description: Build and manage apps on Anhedral through the Anhedral CLI with Codex or Claude Code.

interface.longDescription: Describe an app and use the Anhedral CLI to create or update source, connect projects, configure environments, deploy and inspect runtime logs. Skills guide terminal commands; Platform enforces authentication and project permissions.
defaultPrompt: Build an app on Anhedral from my description, starting with a local preview.
Update my app, run its checks, then deploy it to Anhedral.
